facts.text: Hallmark University delivers undergraduate programs in accelerated 8-week terms across six terms each year, integrating Character Education and Development Programs into student learning.

sources.title: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Artificial Intelligence Degree
sources.quote: Our terms are 8 weeks long. This allows us to have 6 terms a year so there is no need to wait to apply.

sources.title: Hallmark University Character
sources.quote: The Hallmark Character Education and Development Programs foster self-awareness, ethical decision-making, and a commitment to serving others—qualities essential to lifelong success and integrity in all endeavors.
